subject.title: feat(loop): implement autonomous agent loop (/loop) with token budget guard

question: Should OpenClaw add a separate core `/loop` control plane, or should unattended continuation and verification be expressed by extending the existing `/goal`, tasks, subagent, or plugin surfaces?
rationale: VISION.md currently rejects duplicate heavy orchestration, while this PR adds a parallel command, tool set, state model, persistence layer, and TUI lifecycle; code review cannot choose that permanent product boundary.

options.title: Use existing goal surfaces
options.body: Define the missing continuation or verification behavior and extend the canonical `/goal` and task control plane without adding a parallel loop state machine.

options.title: Move it to a plugin
options.body: Package the optional opinionated five-phase workflow as a plugin or skill using existing task, goal, and subagent APIs, adding a narrow core API only if a concrete gap is proven.

options.title: Sponsor a core loop
options.body: Explicitly approve a separate core `/loop` product and require a redesigned shared-runtime implementation with canonical storage and all-surface lifecycle semantics.

recommendation.title: Use existing goal surfaces
recommendation.body: Define the missing continuation or verification behavior and extend the canonical `/goal` and task control plane without adding a parallel loop state machine.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this owner to existing loop-safety behavior and repository-wide architecture decisions.
